scope.actual_packet: nativePacket is original AS.receiver/nextSeed/nextBase before original LowVar equality transport. native_packet_actual is rfl to original nativeAfterAdmission. actual_next_packet uses CP118 original packetAt_successor plus this exact native packet and born transport, identifying the whole Sigma next packet.
scope.receiver_ast: receiver_input is full HEq to N.input(actualMaterial(oldFrame,oldCfg)); receiver_ast is N.expression of that source actionReader material. The old raw is not replaced by a liftExpr identity. Born AST remains the actual selected frame.request input expression.
scope.scalar_history: Every old scalar event, including the complete relation word, uses original carried_scalar/liftEvent and exact language transport into AS.scalar. Generic source membership inputs refer to actual old inventory and are not target-equivalent next membership witnesses.
scope.pair_history: Every old pair event maps through prior.map(original liftEvent), mapped_trace, original pairPrior/cast and preserve. Both receiver and born pair inventory consume that entire carried source; no projection or subset-only event selection replaces the trace.
scope.paid_prefix: Every offset through own receipt uses localPaidAt and next_paid on the original paid branch. Both whole inventory fields equal the initial receiver stocks for the full prefix; selected uses that same receipt endpoint.
scope.same_born: bornStock/bornPairStock are the actual original S.nextBorn stockCfg fields. All old lifted events, selected whole paid exposure and generated joint events are in those same actual born stocks.
scope.decoder: decoder_source is original stockCfg nextBase nextEnvironmentReadAt. born_environment consumes the actualVisit event identity and own receipt settlement value to obtain original AS.write(oldPaid+nativeValue). No born Env answer is supplied by caller.
scope.whole_word_action: sourceWordAction is original literal liftMap followed by LowVar equality LinearEquiv. source_word_action_relation identifies it with original liftEvent on whole coefficient relation words. Membership is proved for actual old-stock relations; linear inventory/substitution squares hold for all complete Formal words.
scope.receiver_env_square: receiverEnvironment is original native receiver.registered.input.environment transported only in language. receiverOld/receiverIncrement are its canonical fst/snd projections. word_inventory eliminates language equality and applies original evaluation_liftMap. It does not identify these coordinates with CP117 current-site material oldEnvironment/actualIncrement.
scope.substitution: source_word_action_substitution directly consumes new tracked SubstitutionLift.word for whole words. That theorem is structural Expr induction including original pairLinear/pairBilinear, then Finsupp.lhom_ext preserving every coefficient. It is syntax naturality for supplied binding, not a free physical/runtime next commuting assertion.
scope.direct_consumers: All three Consumer methods start from the same D.packetAt ordinal and consume actual_next_packet. actual_next_inventory bundles all source AST, full prefixes, both old/paid/joint stocks and exact decoder. actual_next_word consumes the actual born word, whole-word inventory square and decoder. actual_next_substitution consumes same next packet and whole substitution square.
scope.authority: Original D.packetAt/currentRuntime/Stage carrier and original controller remain; the whole successor Sigma packet is consumed, with no new root/controller row.
scope.private_helpers: next_paid consumes only the actual paid action equality; public paid_prefix_stocks gets it from original AS.localPaidAt/own receipt. preserve_generated moves actual source-generated trace membership. relation_transport/word_inventory eliminate actual LowVar equality and use original literal laws, with no supplied target result.
scope.index_preservation: Full source words retain literal coefficients, original old/native grade and exact LowVar language transport. Both scalar and pair inventory fields, all actual paid offsets, stopped whole paid trace and generated joint are preserved. Receiver registered Env, decoded born active Env and CP117 current-site old/increment stay at their own indices.
scope.decoder_consumer_precision: Consumer.actual_next_inventory directly consumes both decoder_source (the actual nextEnvironmentReadAt function) and born_environment (the decoded active Env computed from this receipt). Consumer.actual_next_word directly consumes born_environment; its exact decoder claim is the resulting Env equation, not a separate function-equality field.
scope.control_validation: Original exact117 source write1/write0, registered/residual separation, different site labels and nonzero formal const0 with zero completion controls pass; original118 full packet/history and original110 scalar-equal/distinct occurrence/whole field controls pass.
scope.scope_limit: No equation identifies CP117 site old/increment with these receiver fst/snd coordinates; no cross-grade prefix/action quotient-kernel stability, terminal, physical norm/margin payment or additional controller advance is claimed.
scope.trust: Fresh three modules and four gates, matching main OLean bytes; signed118 dependencies only. Every new owned/private/helper declaration has full shared raw type/value DAG and exact syntactic dependency/axiom audit. Failed metadata reader syntax attempt is diagnostic only and excluded from passing evidence.
